caption: The drawing depicts a figure nailed to a wooden cross positioned centrally on a plain off-white background. The cross is colored in shades of gray and black, with thick, rectangular beams and angular ends. The figure is shown with arms extended horizontally and legs together, nailed at the hands and feet. The body is pale with visible ribs and muscle definition, and there are streaks and drops of red on the forehead, chest, arms, and legs, suggesting the presence of blood. The figure has a beard, long dark hair, and a crown of thorns on the head. Around the waist, there is a wrapped green cloth with dark green outlines. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is a handwritten signature reading "Michael G. Claflin-Taos-N.M." The background of the image is devoid of other objects or details.
title: Cristo, Carved and Painted, on Black Carved Wooden Cross
